queueRef.title: Request Queue (name or ID)
queueRef.description: Name or ID of the Request Queue to clean (e.g. 'fb-url-profiles').

pageSize.title: Page size
pageSize.description: How many requests to scan per API page.

maxScan.title: Max requests to scan
maxScan.description: Optional cap for smoke tests. Leave empty to scan the whole queue.

dryRun.title: Dry-run (no deletions)
dryRun.description: If true, do not delete anything — only report what WOULD be deleted.
